title: Lightning Lord
summary: Defeat every loyalist before the Lightning Lord can consume one to restore his health.
overview: Defeat every loyalist before the Lightning Lord can consume one to restore his health.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Clear each loyalist and stop boss damage near fifteen percent until the final add is dead.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The last nervous guardian's death summons the Lightning Lord.
A loyalist joins at 90%, 75%, 60%, 45%, 30% and 15% health.
Below 15%, a surviving loyalist can be destroyed by the boss to return him to full health.
Electric Shock repeats every thirty seconds.

notes: Approval E398. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
